facts.fact: The territorial administration ministry's presentation of the RAVEC system shows birth declarations being registered in the City-web application and passed through a MorphoCivis/City-web interface for calculation of the NINA; it does not say at which offices, and gives no date for this, so the document's 2016 date is used (its results table is as at 20 April 2016).

systems.owner: Ministère de l'Administration Territoriale et des Collectivités Locales (presenter)

systems.tiers: Passes a registered birth declaration to matching, NINA calculation and insertion in the population file, and returns the NINA

systems.country_label: Recensement Administratif à Vocation d'Etat Civil (RAVEC); base de données RAVEC; fichier population; NINA
systems.owner: Ministère de l'Administration Territoriale et des Collectivités Locales
systems.tiers: A biometric census of citizens inside and outside the country: 14,300,533 enrolled against 13,484,576 forecast at 20 April 2016

note: A slide deck. A modern civil status system covering the whole country by thin client is stated as a long-term objective of RAVEC, not as something in place; the City_Web section itself carries no text beyond its heading.
